named-query.name: video.findByKeyword
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.video FROM favorite f WHERE f.video.title LIKE :keyword

named-query.name: video.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT f.video FROM favorite f WHERE f.user.id = :id

named-query.name: video.findInRange
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.video FROM favorite f WHERE f.likeDate BETWEEN :min AND :max

named-query.name: video.findInMonths
named-query.query: SELECT DISTINCT f.video FROM favorite f WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.likeDate) IN (:months)
